about: Every item somebody can come to hold and every way it comes into the world. sources is the kinds, in this order; via is each source with where it was read. An item with no sources is one a live recipe asks for and nothing hands out. Balance is what a thing takes to make or get plus its stats, never gold (Patrick, 22 Oct 2026, #3135).

kinds.crafted: made at a bench by a profession, by anybody where no profession owns the recipe, or made by the server in place of a recipe's output (fine and burnt dishes, hair dye)
kinds.race: a recipe only the named race may make
kinds.company: a Free Skyrim Trading Company ware (cut-items.json rieklingKept)
kinds.faction: a recipe only the embassy roll or the remnant roll may make
kinds.quest: drawn only while a merchant's scarce work is open, a rare seam its quest opens, or a retrieval token
kinds.gathered: a class's work: picked, grown, fished, hunted, mined or pressed
kinds.found: created by a dungeon chest or a body
kinds.start: handed to a new character: first clothes, a class's tool, a farmer's first seeds

notSources: a cut recipe, a tempering row (grindstone, armour table), a Hearthfire building row, a deed, key or key mold (named claim papers), and gold

via.table: game/gamemode.js NEEDS.waterItems, an empty bottle filled at a well or the water bucket
